title: Team Config (config.yml)
description: Committable, credential-free team configuration at .specify/jira/config.yml (repo root, never in the extension folder). Business-language keys (Constitution XVI). Validation MUST reject any credential-shaped value (FR-023): the ATATT token prefix, a real *.atlassian.net host, or an email/token shape in any string value. Presented as JSON Schema; the on-disk file is YAML.

version_compat.description: Advisory: extension version range the config was authored against. Read-only; the authoritative version is the manifest's extension.version field in .specify/extensions/jira/extension.yml (FR-021).

routing.description: Ordered rules mapping specs/<pattern> to a project (FR-041). First match wins.

spec_label.description: A label declared inside the spec.

routing_default.description: OPTIONAL since 033 (FR-003). The last of four routing ranks: a `routing` rule, then a `teams[]` folder_prefix, then the team the developer selected in the gitignored personal.yml, then this. A repository shared by several teams may omit it — there is no value that is correct for all of them — and let each developer route through their own selection. Optional means MAY BE ABSENT, never may be malformed: a declared value that is not a project key is still refused.

allowlist.description: Domains/hosts that produce neither block nor warning (FR-053). Documentation Atlassian/Confluence hosts belong here.

projectKey.description: A Jira project key. Public within the org, therefore permitted in the committable config.

style.description: Detected from project.style/simplified and persisted by logical value (FR-004).

link_type.description: Logical link-type name. REQUIRED iff task_strategy = linked_story.

hierarchy.description: Logical level names, top-down. For team_managed projects a level above Epic is rejected at config time (FR-007).

issue_types.description: Map logical name -> resolved Jira id. No literal Atlassian default appears in scripts (FR-010).

phase_status_map.description: Map spec phase -> status (many-to-one). Two consecutive phases on one status produce no transition (FR-011).

status_classification.description: Map status -> exactly one category, per project (FR-011, FR-034).

estimation_field.description: Operator-confirmed discovered estimation field (logical descriptor). For team_managed it is the project's own field, never the global Story Points custom field (FR-006, FR-018).

generation.description: Content-generation options; each key MUST be tied to an FR and exercised by a test (Constitution XV).

design_section.description: Emit the Design section from Figma links/UX guidance (FR-016).
